syncKind.description: Kind of sync to run. api: live API fetch; csv: CSV ingestion; prices: price refresh.

triggerSource.description: What initiated the sync (used for auditing/telemetry).

syncMode.description: Sync strategy. incremental: resume from latest ledger. resync_from_start: delete this integration's prior data, then re-fetch from scratch. resync: accepted for backward compatibility, normalized to incremental. Defaults to incremental when omitted.

functions.description: Sync only these provider functions (e.g. one). Empty/omitted = all enabled. Unknown names → 400.

endTime.description: Unix ms window end (defaults to now).
